title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Show parents the plan
hook: Do your team's parents know what you work on at practice?
intro: A parent asks why practice was all bunting.
q1: Do you share a short weekly plan with parents —
q2: or keep practice details within the team?
q3: What would parents practice at home if they knew?
t1: Both can work. But parents back you up
t2: when they know what the team is working on.
cta: Coaches — do you share your plan?
ctaLines: A weekly note. A one-line focus. Nothing at all.
Share it or keep it simple?
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do your team's parents know what you work on at practice?
A parent asks why practice was all bunting. They missed the reason.
Parents support what they understand.
Share the plan or keep it in the team. There is no single right way.
Do you share your plan? Share your habit in the comments.
